directories.description: The content of Reference Architecture and Guidance for Digital Public Infrastructure for the Health Sector — its document, chapters and blocks.

Source material, frozen. who-dpi-h-reference-architecture-draft-v1/ holds the review version exactly as circulated (line-numbered PDF and .docx), plus the extraction (docx-structure.json) and the page/line map (pdf-line-map.json) the folio and every public comment's anchor are derived from. Never edited to answer a comment.

The ArchiMate models of the reference architecture, one folder per SemVer version (archimate/README.md), named by cat-archimate.config.json. cat-harness's archimate subgraph (skill archimate-models) gives every view, element and relationship a page and an IRI and draws every view as SVG — no Java, no Archi CLI; the site build writes them at en/dpi-h-ra/archimate/<version>/.

The public-review record: one public-comment/1.0.0 file per comment (comments/PC-0042.json), one changeset/1.0.0 file per change-set (changesets/CS-012.json), one manifest per intake batch (batches/), and config.json naming the editors and review committee. A public comment is a todo kind, so anything that reads todos reads these. Moved only by folio-assistant-core/scripts/public-comment.ts. The original spreadsheets hold reviewers' emails and are NOT kept here.
Inbox for material not yet ingested.

The work plan: one bean per Markdown file (prefix dpi-h-ra-, per .beans.yml). Kept on the tip-keyed state branch cat/dpi-h-ra/beans, mounted here; owner decision 2026-10-06. Until the separate cutover removes beans/ from main, main's copy is the source of truth and the branch is a seed (manifest.json: status seed, authoritative false).

Todos: items, per-block feedback and review verdicts, as declared by todos/todos.json. Kept on the tip-keyed state branch cat/dpi-h-ra/todos, mounted here; owner decision 2026-10-06. Until the separate cutover removes todos/ from main, main's copy is the source of truth and the branch is a seed (manifest.json: status seed, authoritative false).

The trashcan that is kept: deprecated and removed content, each node declaring itself folio-fsh-guts/v1 with where it came from. Kept on the tip-keyed state branch cat/dpi-h-ra/fsh-guts, mounted here, never rendered. Holds the snapshots of beans/ and todos/ as main last tracked them before their 2026-10-06 cutover (owner: "cutover dirs should go to fsh-guts").

This instance's glossary: folio-glossary/v1 SKOS schemes. dpi-h-ra.glossary.json is the RA's own glossary, read verbatim from its glossary table, the shared scheme the Digital Transformation Handbooks link their terms to (#133). full-stac.glossary.json holds the terms of Mehl et al. 2023 (the full-STAC paper, library/mehl-2023-full-stac-oqad018/), which the RA cites and its own scheme links to. dpi-h-ra-acronyms.glossary.json holds the RA's acronyms list, one concept per acronym (notation and expansion), from which the acronyms table is drawn; glossary-tables.json names the document tables drawn from these schemes (Tool glossary-table, #206). organizations.glossary.json holds the organizations the handbooks name (WHO, HL7, ISO, GS1, UNICEF, USAID, ...), once, as SKOS concepts with a foaf:focus to a W3C ORG organization (litlfred/folio-assistant-core#411); a handbook lists them under members.

dpi-h-ra's bibliography: one folio-reference/v1 CSL-JSON entry per cited work, `<key>.json`. The paper cites them by key (`\cite{key}` in a block's text, and `cites` on its manifest), each citation links to its entry on the KG Bibliography page (`en/folio-assistant-core/bibliography/#ref-<key>`), and the References chapter's list is generated from them by `references:render`. Footnotes are kept only for notes that explain rather than cite.
